pairs: Cecineruntque Debbora et Barac filius Abinoëm in illo die, dicentes:
In that day, Deborah and Barak, the son of Abinoam, sang out, saying:
Qui sponte obtulistis de Israël animas vestras ad periculum,
“All you of Israel who have willingly offered your lives to danger,
It is I, it is I,
who will sing to the Lord.
quæ Domino canam, psallam Domino Deo Israël.
I will sing a psalm to the Lord, the God of Israel!
and you crossed through the regions of Edom,
the earth and the heavens were moved,
and the clouds rained down water.
The mountains flowed away before the face of the Lord,
et Sinai a facie Domini Dei Israël.
and Sinai, before the face of the Lord God of Israel.
In the days of Shamgar, the son of Anath,
in the days of Jael, the paths were quiet.
until a mother rose up in Israel.
and he himself overturned the gates of the enemies.
clypeus et hasta si apparuerint in quadraginta millibus Israël.
A shield with a spear was not seen among the forty thousand of Israel.
My heart loves the leaders of Israel. All you who,
qui propria voluntate obtulistis vos discrimini,
of your own free will, offered yourselves during a crisis,
You who ride upon donkeys laboring,
and you who sit in judgment,
and you who walk along the way,
Where the chariots were struck together,
and the army of the enemies was choked, in that place,
let the justices of the Lord be described,
and let his clemency be for the brave of Israel.
tunc descendit populus Domini ad portas,
Then did the people of the Lord descend to the gates,
The remnants of the people were saved.
The Lord contended with the strong.
Ex Ephraim delevit eos in Amalec,
Out of Ephraim, he destroyed those with Amalek,
et post eum ex Benjamin in populos tuos,
and after him, out of Benjamin, those of your people,
et de Zabulon qui exercitum ducerent ad bellandum.
and from Zebulun, those who led the army to war.
The commanders of Issachar were with Deborah,
and they followed the steps of Barak,
like one rushing headlong into a chasm.
Contention was found among great souls.
Why do you live between two borders,
so that you hear the bleating of the flocks?
Contention was found among great souls.
and Dan was occupied with ships.
Asher was living on the shore of the sea,
et Nephthali obtulerunt animas suas morti in regione Merome.
Zebulun and Naphtali offered their lives to death in the region of Merom.
the kings of Canaan fought at Taanach,
pugnaverunt reges Chanaan in Thanach juxta aquas Mageddo,
And yet they took no spoils.
De cælo dimicatum est contra eos:
The conflict against them was from heaven.
remaining in their order and courses,
The torrent of Kishon dragged away their carcasses,
The hoofs of the horses were broken,
while the strongest of the enemies fled away with fury,
et per præceps ruentibus fortissimis hostium.
said the Angel of the Lord.
quia non venerunt ad auxilium Domini,
For they did not come to the aid of the Lord,
to the assistance of his most valiant men.’
Benedicta inter mulieres Jahel uxor Haber Cinæi,
Blessed among women is Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite.
And blessed is she in her tabernacle.
He begged her for water, and she gave him milk,
et in phiala principum obtulit butyrum.
and she offered him butter in a dish fit for princes.
She put her left hand to the nail,
and her right hand to the workman’s mallet.
Percussitque Sisaram quærens in capite vulneri locum,
And she struck Sisera, seeking in his head a place for the wound,
He fainted away and passed on.
He curled up before her feet,
and he lay there lifeless and miserable.
His mother gazed through a window
And she spoke from an upper room:
‘Why does his chariot delay in returning?
Why are the feet of his team of horses so slow?’
Una sapientior ceteris uxoribus ejus, hæc socrui verba respondit:
One who was wiser than the rest of his wives responded to her mother-in-law with this:
‘Perhaps he is now dividing the spoils,
and the most beautiful among the women is being selected for him.
vestes diversorum colorum Sisaræ traduntur in prædam,
Garments of diverse colors are being delivered to Sisera as spoils,
et supellex varia ad ornanda colla congeritur.
and various goods are being collected for the adornment of necks.’
O Lord, so may all your enemies perish!
But may those who love you shine with splendor,
sicut sol in ortu suo splendet, ita rutilent.
as the sun shines at its rising.”
And the land rested for forty years.
